ownerSelectedScope: After clarification, the owner selected a smaller batch within existing 3–6-letter rules instead of including longer words.
method: Exact-spelling deduplication against dictionary/content/level JSON and all VOCABULARY review JSON and text documents, including approved, rejected, skipped and unselected spellings. Screened cached six-letter noun/adjective discovery lists and additional everyday suggestions; individually verified the proposed senses in the linked language or official country-name sources.
poolFinding: The earlier review already found familiar unreviewed 3–5-letter words nearly exhausted. This bounded editorial search produced a 30-word review, mainly six-letter candidates. It is not proof that no further suitable words exist. No rare technical, archaic or verbal-action filler was added to reach 100.

familiarityTiers.A: Relatively direct ordinary sense, by assistant editorial judgment.
familiarityTiers.B: School, culture, geography or less frequent wording; owner familiarity judgment especially important.

limitations: The exact 19 selected senses are approved; all await integration. Active revision 30 remains at 2,306 required approvals and 500 levels.
The other 11 spellings remain unapproved for required use; the owner did not explicitly exclude them from all gameplay. Do not propose any of these 30 reviewed spellings again as new.
No boards were generated for these additions. Campaign fit, capacity and repetition benefits remain unmeasured.
Country names are individually approved; other proper names and origin labels gain no approval.
All existing spelling, sense, grammar, length, layout, pacing and 75-level-gap rules remain.
sourceAttribution: Georgian explanatory dictionary / Linguistic Technologies Group; NPLG hosted dictionaries; National Bank of Georgia (currency name only); Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Geostat; Sakpatenti. Links and short original/adapted English glosses, no full definitions.
